headline: Explore the globe in field recordings
summary: Discover the world through immersive field recordings with Earth Garden. The app offers a globe to explore real-world soundscapes. Perfect for background listening or active appreciation of nature and urban sounds.

headline: iPhone Handoff will seamlessly share one number between two phones
summary: iOS 27 introduces the new iPhone Handoff feature later this month. Seamlessly switch between two iPhones using a single phone number. A new demo clip details how to set up this anticipated functionality.

headline: CD sales are booming as physical media continues its resurgence
summary: CD sales exploded by 45.7% in the first half of 2026, per RIAA data. 17.5 million CDs were sold, up from 12 million the previous year. This signals a strong and continued resurgence for physical media formats.

headline: Fantasy Footballers’ Andy Holloway is a dedicated zero-inbox kinda guy
summary: Andy Holloway, cohost of the popular Fantasy Footballers podcast, practices a 'zero-inbox' email philosophy. His show boasts over 2 million monthly listeners and multiple industry awards. Learn how this productivity hack contributes to his success.

headline: How to Watch the September 2026 Nintendo Direct and Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct
summary: Nintendo is hosting two major Direct showcases back-to-back in September 2026. A general Nintendo Direct will be followed by a special Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct. Get all the essential details on how and when to watch these anticipated events.

headline: Left 4 Dead 2 Dev Admits Valve Intentionally Leaked Its Own Trailer After the ESRB Blocked It from Release
summary: Former Valve writer Chet Faliszek confessed that Valve intentionally leaked the Left 4 Dead 2 trailer. The studio released the trailer themselves after the ESRB blocked its official debut. This surprising admission reveals a behind-the-scenes tactic.

headline: Insomniac Clears the Air After Marvel's Wolverine Fans Confuse Lady Deathstrike for Psylocke
summary: Insomniac Games clarified a character identity in the new Marvel's Wolverine trailer. Fans mistook Lady Deathstrike for Psylocke, sparking online discussion. The developer quickly addressed the confusion to set the record straight.

headline: Zach Cregger Says He's Done With Franchise Films After Resident Evil
summary: Director Zach Cregger announced he will no longer direct franchise films. His upcoming Resident Evil adaptation will be his final project in the genre. Cregger seeks new creative ventures beyond established movie series.

headline: US envoys set for Ukraine talks after meeting Putin in Russia
summary: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner recently met with Putin in Russia. They are now traveling to Kyiv for high-stakes talks on Ukraine. This marks their first diplomatic visit to the Ukrainian capital.

headline: TV presenter among 12 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
summary: Egyptian TV presenter Sarah Khalifa has been sentenced to death in a major drugs case. She is one of 12 individuals who received the death penalty. Khalifa was known for her crime-focused program, Mission Impossible.

headline: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
summary: Aviation faces increasing challenges from hotter temperatures and stormier skies. Climate change effects are intensifying, leading to more volatile weather patterns. Passengers may need to accept more frequent delays and diversions going forward.

headline: Temperatures could climb to 28C in late burst of warmth
summary: Parts of the region are set for a late burst of warmth, with temperatures potentially reaching 28C. A summer-like day is anticipated for Sunday in certain areas. However, this warm spell is expected to be short-lived.
